Name: Configurable Junimo Hut
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Allows you the option to choose if the Wizard or Robin builds the Junio Huts. Gives you early access if you want. You can also adjust the price and choose no materials needed. If you want materials, you can adjust the amounts needed. 

There is an optional letter from the Wizard with a gift of raisins and a prismatic shard for getting your first Jumino hut. There is also the option to change the appearance of the Junimo hut to a seasonal tree.  This mod will work with other appearance mods if you select not to use the optional appearance change.

Two separate files for Android since it does not work with GMCM.  The two files are (1) double the price and materials for the Junimo Hut and (2) half the price and materials for the Junimo Hut. You can also manually modify the content file which avoids the need for GMCM.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Download the mod.  Extract into the same folder as other mods. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
Content Pather
